summary_1line: Krishna visits Duryodhana’s court as envoy, refuses his lavish hospitality on moral grounds, and instead chooses to stay and eat at Vidura’s house.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna enters Duryodhana’s grand hall where a thousand kings sit around the throne, and Duryodhana rises to greet him amid glittering splendor.
Krishna raises his arm in the royal court and firmly declares he will not eat Duryodhana’s food because of the king’s hatred for the Pandavas.
Krishna leaves the shining palace and walks to the humble home of Vidura, where he is warmly received and offered simple food.
